name: Indiana
sources: Rate 2.95% for 2026: IC 6-3-2-1 as amended by HEA 1001-2023; Indiana DOR 2026 withholding update (reported by Bloomberg Tax, Dec 2025)
Exemptions ($1,000 per filer and dependent, $1,500 additional per dependent child, $1,000 per person 65+/blind): IT-40 Schedule 3, 2025 (State Form 53997, R16/9-25)
Homeowner's residential property tax deduction, lesser of tax paid or $2,500 ($1,250 MFS): IT-40 Schedule 2, 2025 (State Form 53996, R16/9-25)
County tax = IT-40 line 7 x county rate: Schedule CT-40, 2025 (State Form 47907); county rates: Indiana DOR Departmental Notice #1 (in.gov/dor/files/dn01.pdf, rates effective Oct 1, 2026)
provisional: Exemption amounts are from the 2025 IT-40 Schedule 3 (fixed in statute, not indexed); 2026 forms not yet published
Homeowner's property tax deduction cap ($2,500; $1,250 married filing separately) is from the 2025 IT-40 Schedule 2
County rate 1.97% is the median of the 92 county rates in Departmental Notice #1 (October 2026 edition), not your county's rate
Dependent exemption is $2,500 (the $1,000 exemption plus the $1,500 extra for a child under 19 or a full-time student under 24); other dependents get only $1,000
notes: County income tax uses the median Indiana county rate, 1.97%; actual rates run from 0.5% to 3.0% (Marion County 2.02%, Hamilton 1.1%, Lake 1.5%).
